# NFG

> NFG publishes tools and ready-to-install packages for Anvil Empires players.

## Localized project index

- [English](https://nfg-system.online/en/)
- [Русский](https://nfg-system.online/ru/)
- [Español](https://nfg-system.online/es/)
- [Deutsch](https://nfg-system.online/de/)
- [Français](https://nfg-system.online/fr/)
- [Italiano](https://nfg-system.online/it/)
- [Português (Brasil)](https://nfg-system.online/pt-br/)
- [简体中文](https://nfg-system.online/zh-cn/)
- [日本語](https://nfg-system.online/ja/)
- [한국어](https://nfg-system.online/ko/)
- [Türkçe](https://nfg-system.online/tr/)

- [Anvil Planner](https://anvil-planner.nfg-system.online/)

- [Anvil Empires Turkish localization](https://github.com/Aneonfas/anvil-empires-localizations/releases/download/tr-v1.0.0/Anvil-Empires-Turkish-v1.0.0-steam-build-25584311.zip)

## Notes

- The Russian, Spanish, Turkish and German localization links point to ready release archives.
- Spanish localization: Version 1.1.0-beta.2 is available. In-game verification is pending. The next test date remains in English.
- Turkish localization: selected screens checked in game by the user; comprehensive runtime and native-speaker review remain pending.
- German localization: beta 1.0.0-beta.1, 3,233 entries; runtime visual QA and native-speaker review are pending.
- NFG Hub is the Windows catalog and installer for supported NFG packages.
- Canonical page metadata and sitemap.xml remain the authoritative discovery sources.
